ios.desc:
Discover a Smarter Way to Reach Your Goals with Body AI!

Body AI is your ultimate AI-powered companion for weight management and healthy living. Whether you’re looking to shed pounds, maintain your weight, or simply make healthier choices, Body AI is here to guide you with intelligence and ease.

Key Features:

AI Meal Logging
Log your meals effortlessly by typing what you ate or uploading a photo. Body AI’s advanced technology analyzes your meals, providing detailed nutritional insights and helping you track calories, macros, and more with exceptional accuracy.

Nutritional Insights
Instantly understand the nutritional value of your meals. Body AI offers actionable tips to help you balance your diet and achieve your personal health goals.

Personalized Meal Suggestions
Receive daily meal ideas tailored to your preferences, lifestyle, and weight management objectives. The more you log, the smarter your recommendations get!

Recipilot
Input any recipe, and Body AI calculates the full nutritional breakdown. Easily tweak recipes to suit your dietary needs or make them healthier.

Menubot
Eating out? Send Body AI the menu, and it will suggest the healthiest options based on your goals and preferences.

Progress Tracking
Stay motivated with clear, intuitive charts and summaries of your calorie intake, macro balance, and weight trends. Set goals and see your progress every step of the way.

Transform your approach to weight management with Body AI—the intelligent assistant designed to help you succeed.

Download now and take the first step towards a healthier, happier you!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a weight-loss app using OpenAI APIs

quotes.text:
Hey HN, wanted to show you my weekend project (several weekends actually).

A few months back I started experimenting with LLMs as a way to estimate calories/macros and give useful feedback. The results were good enough that I felt like something was there. I wanted to shed a few pounds so I built out a web app for myself. A few friends tried it and everyone said "this needs to be a native app".

So I converted the Rails app to just be an API backend and built an iOS app in SwiftUI. It just got approved in the (US) app store last week.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fatgpt-ai-weight-loss-coach/id6478470228

Feature-wise it's pretty simple compared to MFP or Noom. But I've been logging my food every day for a while now and am down 12 pounds.

It's been really fun to build and I'm trying to release a new version every week.

Happy to hear any feedback or answer questions.
